extracted.name: Prosciutto Wrapped Asparagus
extracted.description: Roasted asparagus wrapped in prosciutto with creamy soft French cheese is an easy and elegant appetizer or side dish to prep that's sure to impress.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Spread prosciutto slices with Neufchatel cheese. Wrap slices around 2 or 3 asparagus spears. Arrange wrapped spears in a single layer on a medium baking sheet.
Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until asparagus is tender.
